entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I hope you can help. I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker that I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 16 days ago. To best help you, can you tell me, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's still in the box, completely unopened. My situation just... changed unexpectedly, and I really, really need the money back right now.

I understand that things can change. Because it isn't a technical issue, I do need to review our return policy with you. The VeloBand Pulse, since it's a personal health device that links to an account, has a strict 10-day return window. I see here we're on day 16, which is unfortunately outside of that specific policy.

Oh, no. 10 days? I had no idea. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years... I just couldn't deal with it. My father was rushed to the **hospital**; it was a real **emergency**. He had to have unexpected **surgery** and I've been there with him this whole time. This is the first chance I've had to even think about anything else.

I am so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly difficult, and I hope your father is recovering well. Please don't worry about the return window. In cases of a documented medical event or something like a sudden military **deployment**, we absolutely make exceptions.
He's doing a bit better, thank you. But... you can make an exception? That would be such a huge help. With all the unexpected costs, I've been so worried.

Of course. Given the circumstances, I've been authorized to approve a one-time exception for you. I am processing a full refund to your original payment method right now. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly, along with a prepaid shipping label to send the band back to us.
Really? Oh, thank you! Thank you so much, Charlie. You have no idea what a relief that is. I was so worried. This really helps my family.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. The refund should appear back in your account within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so kind and understanding.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your father a swift recovery. Have a good rest of your day.
